contradiction_resolution: No claim-level contradiction: contradicts_claim_ids is empty, and the statement does not oppose CONJ-0001, THM-0001–THM-0007, OBS-0001, or RED-0001. It is compatible with THM-0005 (c(6)=5 so n=6 lies outside published CKgP) and with the packet C66-GEO-Z bottleneck (balanced tetragonal F=O(4)⊕O(5), failure from the f_2=5 summand of SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6). Primary check against SRC-0004 (Canning–Larson, arXiv:2208.02357v2) Lemma 10.6: deg(W_{f_i}|_C)=4g+12-4f_i and the obstruction degree is deg(ω_C⊗W_{f_i}^∨(Γ))=4f_i+n-2g-14, with vanishing of H^0 whenever this degree is negative. Substituting g=6 yields n-10 for f=4 and n-6 for f=5. Hence: (i) for n≤9, deg_{f=4}≤-1 so the f=4 summand vanishes identically; (ii) for n≤5, deg_{f=5}≤-1 as well, so both summands vanish and the CE evaluation-failure locus is empty on the balanced tetragonal locus; (iii) at n=6, deg_{f=5}=0 while deg_{f=4}=-4, so the whole obstruction is carried by the f=5 summand and, for an invertible sheaf of degree 0 on a smooth curve, H^0≠0 iff the sheaf is trivial, i.e. evaluation fails on Γ iff O_C(Γ)≅L:=W_5⊗ω_C^{-1}; (iv) for n≥7, deg_{f=5}≥1 so nonvanishing is a positive-degree Brill–Noether-type condition rather than a pure Abel–Jacobi isomorphism. Consequently the degree-0 Abel–Jacobi identification used for (6,6) is structurally specific to the borderline n=6 and does not transport to neighbouring n by the same argument. Compatible with and complementary to corroborated FND-0062 (f=4 degree −4 vanishes at n=6) and FND-0063 (f=5 degree 0 gives the AJ form at n=6); those are the (6,6) specializations, while FND-0074 is the n-parametric critical-puncture obstruction (equivalence_group geo-z-n6-is-the-critical-puncture-number). Compatible with FND-0005 (Z nonempty at (6,6) by RR on the degree-0 L) and with FND-0061 (degree control is not by itself a complete CE identification unless the H^0 groups are shown to be the CE obstruction spaces—the present finding is only the degree arithmetic of those summands). Mild scope sharpening only: emptiness for n≤5 and the AJ/BN dichotomy are statements on the balanced CE family with smooth geometric fibres, not on all of M_{6,n}; unbalanced types and other genera are outside scope. Distinct from FND-0062/FND-0063: do not merge. Merge target: none.
